description: Consolidate duplicated outbound HTTP validation, remove obsolete allowed_hosts/to_req_options paths, harden channels execution against event option bypasses, and keep redirects visible in BO as disabled/future-only while persisting false.

comments.text: Hardened outbound HTTP cleanup: Channels.Api no longer forwards event opts/http_module into HttpClient, HttpClient test req_options can no longer override protected method/url/redirect/retry, response size now comes from BO policy only, HttpRequest.build delegates to Validator and obsolete allowed_hosts/to_req_options code/tests were removed. Redirect remains visible in BO but disabled and forced false in policy changesets with future-update copy. Focused cleanup suite passed: 301 tests, 0 failures. mix q passed with Credo no issues.

title: Outbound HTTP cleanup and security hardening
